items.detail: That experimental finding establishes what the human cognitive apparatus does automatically when presented with a boundary marker.

items.title: 14:17 · Section 2 1 formalizes how a political-economic
items.detail: Section 2.1 formalizes how a political-economic architecture captures that automatic binary and scales it into a multi-tier extraction hierarchy.

items.title: 14:25 · We introduce four standard operations from elementary
items.detail: We introduce four standard operations from elementary set theory, spoken in plain words so every symbol on screen is transparent.

items.title: 14:33 · A set is a well-defined collection of
items.detail: A set is a well-defined collection of people in a society, and a subset is a smaller group contained entirely inside a larger set.

items.title: 14:42 · The union of two sets joins all
items.detail: The union of two sets joins all members of both groups together, while the intersection identifies only the people who belong to both sets simultaneously.
